entities.summary: Luigi Sante Da Rios was an Italian mathematician and physicist who worked on fluid dynamics. In his 1906 work "Sul moto d'un liquido indefinito con un filetto vorticoso di forma qualunque", he presented the basic equations for the vortex filament model, today used to simulate quantised vortex lines in superfluids.
